**Modified Sounds:** Background music 

**Author:** Zamius

**Description:** Changes Summoner’s Rift Classic theme background music to Winter Rift’s music from the 2016-2017 season.
##
**COMBO RECOMMENDATIONS**

You can also alternatively use the Winter Rift 2023 map that will have the same BGM included as well.
##

**NOTICE**

You need to select the Classic theme from the game's sound settings for this mod to work!
>*A different kind of Christmas song!? FINALLY!*
